name: smwmusic-crash-bash-unused-track
title: Crash Bash - Unused Track
description:
A middle eastern sounding track that can be found in the July 26th 2000 demo in The Official U.S. PlayStation Magazine 38 Demo Disc. It's unknown where it would play in-game but likely it would play in an arabian setting that was scrapped.

Note: Not compatible with Yoshi, thunder and Bonus End.
